name: Guardrails AI
author: guardrails-ai
one_liner: Python framework that runs validators on LLM inputs and outputs and decides what to do when a check fails.

loop.proposes: an LLM response, or a user input headed to the model
loop.judged_by: validators in an input or output Guard, such as RegexMatch, plus custom validators you write
loop.steers: each validator has an on_fail action, for example raising an exception, which blocks or redirects the output

not_proved: A validator only proves the one property it checks. Some hub validators (for example toxic-language checks) are themselves model-based, so they are not pure code judges.
